values.value: Roughly how much is live in HubSpot today — active workflows, lists, marketing emails, landing pages and forms — and across how many business units or portals?

Ask for five numbers, not an adjective: active workflows, lists, marketing emails published in the last 12 months, live landing pages, live forms. Then ask how many portals and (Enterprise only) how many business units.
Useful to have to hand: your counts of active workflows, lists, marketing emails published in the last 12 months, live landing pages and live forms, and the number of portals you run.

migration-accelerator/capabilities/platforms/hubspot.yaml — the object catalogue's own nouns; forms are added to the four hubspot__mcn asks because forms_and_ctas_rebuild makes them a distinct scope item here rather than a subtype of content, and because the site form scan can find embeds the tenant count will not. skills/mce-mcn-helper/references/skills/02-maturity.md — the org-signal method (count the artefacts, do not accept the adjective). Anchors are unchanged from base, which is what keeps this layer 1: a 40-workflow HubSpot estate and a 40-campaign Eloqua estate score the same, which is the point of slot 1.
